4.description: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used, or a required modifier is missing.
4.recovery_strategy: Review modifier requirements for the procedure code and payer contract. Add or correct the modifier and resubmit.

16.description: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s) which is needed for adjudication.
16.recovery_strategy: Review RARC codes to identify specific missing information. Obtain documentation and resubmit corrected claim.

18.recovery_strategy: Verify if original claim was paid. If not a true duplicate (different dates, provider, or service detail), appeal with proof of distinction.

29.description: The time limit for filing has expired.
29.recovery_strategy: Verify actual filing date vs service date. Check for delay reason codes, secondary payer situations, or system errors justifying late filing.

45.description: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
45.recovery_strategy: Contractual write-off per payer contract. Cannot bill patient for the difference.

50.description: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a medical necessity by the payer.
50.recovery_strategy: Gather clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. Appeal with physician notes, diagnostic results, and treatment history showing conservative treatment was exhausted.

96.description: Non-covered charge(s). Benefit plan does not cover this service.
96.recovery_strategy: Verify service coverage under patient plan. Bill patient if service is non-covered and advance beneficiary notice was obtained.

97.description: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service/procedure already adjudicated.
97.recovery_strategy: Review NCCI edits. If services are clinically distinct and separately payable, appeal with documentation proving services were separate and medically necessary.

197.recovery_strategy: Contact payer to request retroactive authorization. Submit clinical necessity documentation. Check if emergency exception applies. Reference payer's retroactive auth policy.

252.description: An attachment/other documentation is required to adjudicate this claim/service.
252.recovery_strategy: Submit required attachments (operative report, lab results, physician notes). Ensure documentation supports the level of service billed.

N30.description: Patient cannot be identified as our insured

N56.description: Procedure code billed is not correct/valid for the service billed or the date of service billed

N104.description: This claim/service is not payable under our claim jurisdiction area.

N115.description: This decision was based on a Local Coverage Determination (LCD).

N386.description: This decision was based on a Local Coverage Determination (LCD). An LCD provides a guide to assist in determining whether a particular item or service is covered.

MA01.description: If you do not agree with what we approved, you may appeal our decision within 6 months of this notice.

MA04.description: Secondary payment cannot be considered without identity of or payment information from the primary payer.

M86.description: Service denied because payment already made for same/similar procedure within set time frame.
